t: Finland declared independence from Russia on 6 December 1917 and became a republic with the constitution of 1919.
It fought the Soviet Union in the Winter War and the Continuation War, losing Karelia but keeping its independence.
A Cold War neutral, it joined the European Union in 1995, adopted the euro in 1999 and joined NATO in 2023.
dyk: The parliamentary reform of 1906 made Finland the first country in Europe where women could both vote and stand for parliament; nineteen women were elected in 1907.
ev: Parliament declares independence from Russia on 6 December
The Whites under Mannerheim win the Finnish Civil War
A new constitution makes Finland a republic, with K. J. Ståhlberg as president
The Soviet Union attacks, starting the Winter War
The Continuation War ends with an armistice and the loss of Karelia
The Helsinki Final Act is signed at the Conference on Security and Co-operation in Europe

f.founder: Pehr Evind Svinhufvud and the Senate of Finland
